edges.reason: Both quotes refer to the same $30 billion funding request by Sean Duffy. The new quote is an op-ed from Oct 1 restating the amount.

edges.sentence: On 2026-10-01, The Hill reported “Duffy recently requested $30 billion in funding.”; on 2026-10-08, The Hill reported “In an Oct. 1 op-ed, Jackson Shedelbower called that day “another reminder” of why Congress should grant Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy’s $30 billion request.”.
